messages.content:
Hi there! 👋 I'm your creative assistant for TwitCanva, here to help you make stunning images and videos for any project you have in mind.

Whether you're:
✅ Brainstorming ideas for social media graphics, wall art, marketing visuals, short-form videos, or just fun personal art
✅ Crafting perfectly tuned AI generation prompts to get exactly the look you want
✅ Looking for feedback on composition, lighting, color palettes, or storytelling for visuals you've already made
✅ Hunting for creative inspiration or pro tips to make your work stand out

I've got you! What are you looking to create today? For example, if you want a cozy fall café illustration, a sleek cinematic product shot, a playful birthday invite graphic, or even a dreamy fantasy landscape, just say the word.
